ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Moon and Saturn at {H:1793205094000}

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Venus retrograde in your relationships sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Venus retrograde in your romance sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Venus retrograde in your communication sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Venus retrograde in your self-image sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Venus retrograde in your friendship sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Venus retrograde in your horizons sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The sextile between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.
